## Purpose
Image component that shows a placeholder element until the real image has loaded in the background, then swaps in an `<img>`. Used by [[src-components-avatar-card]], [[src-components-blog-card]] and [[src-components-external-project-card]].

## Key concepts
- `LazyImage({placeholder, src, alt, ...rest})`; extra props are forwarded to `<img>`.
- A `useEffect` preloads via `new Image()` and sets `loading` false in `onload`.

## Gotchas
- No `onerror` handler: if the image fails to load, the placeholder is shown forever.
- `loading` is not reset to true when `src` changes, so the old image stays until the new one swaps in.
